svg.title: FASTQ files: paired-end reads come in two files in the same order, and each record is four lines: a name, the bases, a plus sign, and one quality character per base
svg.text: Paired-end reads come in two files
The nth record in one file pairs with the nth in the other
A made-up record, shortened to 20 bases
a 1 in 1,000 chance this G is wrong
